name: Tiszatarján (Hungary)
description: Medium blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Tiszatarján (a red and blue shield with white bars, a boat and crossed oars, bordered in yellow) below the name TISZATARJÁN in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
